data.long_meaning: Ruthanne is a combination of Ruth and Anne. Ruth means 'friend' and is derived from the Hebrew root 'ruth' meaning 'friend'. Anne means 'grace' and is derived from the Hebrew name Hannah. Together, Ruthanne means 'friend of God'. The name Ruthanne carries the meaning “Friend of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ruthanne usually hope their child will grow to embody friend of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes strong friendship with God and divine grace.
